regime_context: The detector shows Base Metals & Copper as the dominant theme with full breadth and no crowding. Gold Miners follow with superior trend durability. The absolute-trend gate is the only validated edge (risk-control), and directional accuracy is near 50%, so any directional leans must be held humbly.
emerging_watch: Watch for a potential handoff to Gold Miners: if XGD.TO's momentum score overtakes Base Metals and stays ahead for at least 3 consecutive trading days, it would signal a confirmed leadership change.

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: The theme scores highest in uncrowded momentum with 100% breadth, and the absolute-trend gate confirms eligibility, reducing drawdown risk. Durability is moderate (0.7) but not broken; the mixed hurst reflects current choppiness.
evidence: Crowded=false, no absorption or one-narrative flag
theses.dissent: Copper demand could weaken sharply on a China slowdown, causing a trend reversal; the mixed hurst indicates the trend lacks persistence and could whipsaw.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO underperforms the S&P/TSX Composite by more than 5% total return over the next 20 trading days from 2026-08-07.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners show the highest durability (0.79) and a trending hurst, with full breadth and no crowding. It passes the absolute-trend gate, offering staying power even if it trails the leader in raw momentum.
theses.dissent: A sharp rise in real yields could pressure gold prices, causing miners to underperform; momentum gap to the leader has not yet closed.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO underperforms the S&P/TSX Composite by more than 8% total return over the next 30 trading days from 2026-08-07.

theses.subject: REITs
theses.thesis: REITs score the lowest among eligible themes (rank 16), with extremely weak breadth (0.167) and low durability (0.45), signaling fragile leadership. The absolute-trend gate makes it eligible, but it is an unambiguous laggard.
theses.dissent: A dovish Bank of Canada or falling sovereign yields could trigger a sharp REIT relief rally, given the deeply discounted state.

falsifier.text: XRE.TO outperforms the S&P/TSX Composite by more than 4% total return over the next 20 trading days from 2026-08-07.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
